description: This Java class 'NamingServiceContainer' manages the lifecycle of an RMI naming registry, including initialization, startup, and shutdown, with configuration options for host and port.

classes.name: NamingServiceContainer
classes.description: A container class that manages an RMI naming registry, including initialization, starting, and stopping the service.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the container with configuration, setting host and port for the RMI registry.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the RMI registry and marks the container as running.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the RMI registry if it is running.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the container.
